TL_TET4.rationale: G10 removes the historical absence of any comparable run for a narrow TET4 domain, but the external column stops at 80 percent of critical load and G07-TL-008 still requires a complete compatible response history before TL promotion.

TL_HEX8.rationale: One same-mesh matched point is useful and numerically consistent, but it is not a complete QF/external response history and cannot qualify HEX8 TL as a family route.

ARC_LENGTH.rationale: The selected run demonstrates one reproducible branch and turning point with 75 common comparison points, but it does not establish arc-step/mesh sensitivity, G07-specific restart evidence or production qualification.
